Business meaning: Best customers. They generate high revenue and are very important for the business.
Recommended action: Give VIP benefits, loyalty rewards, early access, and personalized offers.
KPI to monitor: Retention and revenue from VIP customers

Business meaning: Customers with moderate behavior who could buy more with the right offer.
Recommended action: Use cross-selling, product recommendations, bundles, or small discounts.
KPI to monitor: Increase in frequency and average order value

Business meaning: Customers who have not purchased recently and may be inactive or close to being lost.
Recommended action: Use low-cost win-back emails or reactivation campaigns. Avoid expensive campaigns first.
KPI to monitor: Return purchase rate after the win-back campaign
